description: This is a unit test source file for the OrganizationService class in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test cases for methods that retrieve and save organization general information, utilizing mock objects and test data setup.

classes.name: OrganizationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class verifying the behavior of OrganizationService methods related to organization information retrieval and saving, with mock dependencies and test data setup.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creates an instance of OrganizationService, and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Tests that the organization service correctly retrieves organization general information using a mocked DAO.

methods.name: testSaveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Tests that the organization service correctly saves organization general information, verifying the data passed to the DAO.
